prompt: Create ONE standalone botanical illustration for The Vegetable Guru inner pages, not a page layout. The FIRST reference is a real photograph: use it for the vegetable shapes, asymmetry, angles, overlap and natural composition. References 2 and 3 are APPROVED BOOK HERO ART and must govern drawing style: bold simplified silhouettes, broad crisp colour and shadow planes, dimensional hand-shaped vector-like botanical drawing, rich natural crop colours, lime and forest greens, tapered cream highlight slashes and occasional rhythmic scalloped highlights, a few major veins only. No fine ink hatching, no watercolour, no pencil, no grain or mottled texture, no photographic skin gloss, no black outline. Ignore and DO NOT reproduce the reference heroes' green/black background haze. Genuinely transparent PNG background, no glow, no halo, no cast shadow or ground plane, no white backing, no lettering or border. Keep the entire silhouette inside the canvas with 7% clear padding. Large high resolution. Landscape 3:2. Draw the small COURGETTE plant viewed from above in the photograph: five or six differently angled lobed leaves from a connected central crown, one small green courgette with its yellow blossom attached and a second smaller bloom. Keep fruit visible; omit damaged spots and excessive small serrations. Remove soil, tape measure, bricks, cut stems and all background. Compact asymmetrical low plant silhouette, enough space between leaves to understand attachments; not a floral bouquet.
